messages:
maria: FYI we're seeing sustained backpressure on the dedicated scheduler in us-east-1 since ~11:07 UTC. Queue depth on scheduler-ingest is ~3.8x normal and a subset of dedicated customers are seeing tail gen latency spike to 2-5s. Opening incident thread and triage. https://go.redwood/incident/1864503210
 eric: oncall here. throttled new reserved-job submissions to the affected dedicated pool and turned on the burst pool (dedicated-burst-v2) to absorb excess. initial error rate for generate requests down from ~7% to ~1.4%.
 jen: digging in — looks like a reenqueue loop in the scheduler after kv-cache throttles, which amplifies queue pressure. preparing a fix that disables aggressive reenqueue and adds a tighter backoff. will roll a patch to scheduler 1.12.4.
 nate: i've started outreach to the 3 customers who filed support tickets. draft status message is ready for review by cs/sales. tagging customer-success for approvals.
 maria: mitigation checklist: 1) submission throttle for dedicated pools (done), 2) burst pool enabled (done), 3) scheduler patch rolling (in progress), 4) hosted-fallback routes enabled for critical customers, 5) support notifications sent. status page & incident doc: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1864503210
 ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for scheduler 1.12.4 in us-east-1, batch 1/4. sha=abcdef123. CI: https://ci.redwood/build/7890
 eric: batch 1 looks healthy, queue depth down ~25% in the affected shards. monitoring dashboards show error rate trending down. keeping oncall for 2 more hours. if you see regressions react with :loud_sound: or DM.
 support: customer update sent to the 3 impacted accounts. copy used: "We're mitigating an issue impacting Dedicated customers in us-east-1; we've applied temporary throttles and enabled a burst pool. We're rolling a scheduler patch now. We'll follow up when fully resolved."
 jen: after batch 2 the tail latency is back to baseline for ~90% of requests. continuing rollout in batches 3/4 with close monitoring. scheduling postmortem; maria to own.
 maria: setting severity=SEV2 for tracking. i'll post an executive summary and timeline once rollout completes. final incident doc will include RCA and follow-ups. quick link: https://go.redwood/incident/1864503210/updates
